name: SearchSites
description: Searches Microsoft 365 SharePoint sites by keyword using Microsoft Graph API.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 SharePoint Credential
fields.description: Microsoft 365 credential used to authenticate and search SharePoint sites via Microsoft Graph API.

fields.name: SearchQuery
fields.label: Search Keyword
fields.description: The keyword or phrase to search for in SharePoint sites.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns a list of SharePoint sites matching the search query, including their ID, display name, web URL, and other metadata.
